glossary.definition: As used in sections 307.84 to 307.846 of the Revised Code, "county office" means any officer, department, board, commission, agency, court, or other office of the county, other than a board of county hospital trustees.
glossary.source_title: Section 307.84 - Establishing automatic data processing board.
